messages:
Maya: Quick sync — post-launch triage for v1.2. We need a decision: prioritize the P1/P0 bug fixes (rate-limit + timeout) or push small UX enhancements now? Can we take 15?
Samir: 15 here. High level: if it's customer-facing regressions (timeouts/rate-limit) we hotfix first. UX polish can be batched into the next sprint unless it's blocking onboarding.
Devin: Agree. Repro for the rate-limit issue: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
```
We see 429s when concurrent user tokens exceed pool size. Quick estimate: immediate fix ~2 dev-days, root-cause infra work ~5d.
Maya: Customer impact: three enterprise customers hit the limit, one reported timeouts during peak. Jules, can you confirm severity from CS?
Jules: Confirmed — escalations open. Customers want either a backfill or an SLA note. Recommend prioritizing the rate-limit fix, especially for customers on Dedicated/DL plans.
Chris: From SRE perspective, we can mitigate with a temporary LB routing tweak and raise connection pool limits for the short-term. I can push a config change (30m) and monitor.
Samir: Proposed plan: 1) Hotfix release for rate-limit & timeout (canary -> rollback). 2) Move all small UX enhancements to a grooming queue with clear acceptance criteria. 3) Create an infra epic for perf/regression root cause.
Maya: Hotfix launch criteria checklist: unit + integration tests green, canary at 10% for 1h, monitor token latency and 5xx/429 rates, automatic rollback alert. Any objections?
Devin: No objections. I'll open the PR and target EOD tomorrow if no blockers. Will include smoke test script and a short playbook.
Maya: If hotfix ships, let's run a 1-week "stability sprint" focusing on P1 regression fixes. After stability sprint we'll run backlog grooming and prioritize top 3 customer asks into roadmap 1.3.
Samir: +1. For enhancements, require a mock + definition of success (e.g., latency <= X ms or error rate < Y%) before we schedule.
Jules: I'll collect customer asks and score them by severity and ARR impact. Will post a doc by noon tomorrow.
Maya: Action items: Devin -> open PR (#1234), Chris -> LB patch + monitor, Jules -> customer impact doc, Samir -> create infra epic and link tests. I'll pin the recap.
deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled at 2025-05-03T16:00Z for canary=10% (initiated by Devin).
Samir: One more governance note — propose a "ship-or-shelve" gate for enhancements: if a requested enhancement can't be scoped to <3 dev-days, move to roadmap 1.4 backlog. Cuts churn.
Maya: Agreed. We'll enforce the gate in grooming. Reconvene Monday 10:00am for final backlog grooming and 1.3 picks.
Jules: Added notes to the customer tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CUST-482 (summary + ARR impact).
Maya: Thanks everyone :rocket:
